items.title: ניידות ותמרון
items.concept: מסדרון תנועה בין מטע, קרקע רכה ומחסה קשיח.
items.subject: A winding rural mobility corridor through a FLAT agricultural mosaic seen obliquely from above. On left foreground one detailed small olive tracked engineering vehicle follows pale wheel tracks near a low rugged stone wall and dense olive shrubs; a pale solid boulder and shrubs are visibly distinct types of cover. The road winds toward a small modular bridge over a narrow drainage channel in upper left, with ordered orchard rows, a wet clay rut section and contrasting firm sandy track. A tiny amber route marking follows only a short bend in the road. Vehicle, wall, orchard rhythm and road are the clear main story. No guns, tanks firing, towering hills or peaks. Flat richly detailed terrain merging into the parchment.

items.title: קווי ראייה ותצפית
items.concept: אמצעי תצפית ושדה ראייה שנחסם בידי מבנים וצמחייה.
items.subject: A large elegant olive observation binocular instrument on a delicate tripod, in lower-left foreground on a modest ivory observation platform. Beyond it within the left third a miniature flat landscape has a row of medium ivory buildings, a dense olive grove and small clearings. One extremely subtle translucent olive fan-shaped field-of-view emanates from the binoculars toward the upper-left landscape, ending at buildings and grove, leaving a soft unlit shadow wedge behind obstacles. One thin amber sight line toward a tiny pin in an open clearing, all restricted left. Focus on optics, visible and hidden areas; NOT a mountain landscape, no radar screen or neon, no attack imagery. Objects are detailed plaster/paper miniature.

items.title: ניווטים
items.concept: מצפן, מפה מקופלת ומסלול בין נקודות ציון.
items.subject: Close oblique still-life of a beautifully crafted open brass-and-olive lensatic compass on an ivory folded field map, occupying left foreground. The compass face has a star and fine unlabeled ticks only, no numerals or letters. A slim ivory plotting ruler and a pencil lie partially beneath the map. On the map a tiny paper road follows the edge of a sparse olive woodland, crosses a narrow stream and links three tiny amber waypoint pins. The map subtly transforms into shallow 3D paper land features toward upper left, with a small fork in the road. The compass is the unmistakable hero, with rich materials and delicate warm shadows. No mountain peaks, no digital devices.

items.title: אקלים, מזג אוויר ועונתיות
items.concept: תחנת מזג אוויר, ערפל ודרך רטובה.
items.subject: A detailed miniature weather station with slender mast, cup anemometer and restrained amber windsock in LEFT foreground, rooted in a flat olive-and-ivory countryside. Behind it a layered sculpted ivory low cloud and translucent mist bank hang over a shallow drainage basin, soft rain threads land on a wet rutted road and small muted blue-grey puddles. A small olive utility vehicle is partly veiled by mist in the middle-left, showing weather changing visibility and ground condition. Wind direction indicated by physical windsock only. Light cream atmospheric scene, ivory clouds, soft taupe shadows, no dramatic dark storm sky, no sun icons, no mountains, no scientific equations. Strong elegant cloud-and-mast silhouette contained in left third.

items.title: תשתיות ולוגיסטיקה
items.concept: מרכז תובלה המחבר מסילת רכבת, כביש ורציף.
items.subject: An intricate intermodal logistics hub, high oblique miniature, completely in LEFT third. Lower-left cargo train with several olive and ivory freight containers curves alongside a pale warehouse and a road with two tiny cargo trucks. Upper-left a tall fine olive gantry crane stands over an ivory quay and a small dusty blue-grey harbor inset. Rail and road join through one small bridge so the connected supply network reads clearly. One tiny amber container or junction marker only. Main silhouettes are crane, train, warehouses, container stacks and road geometry, rich disciplined architectural detail. Flat land, no mountains, no firing weapons, no central island pedestal, no unrelated props.

items.title: משאבים, אנרגיה וגיאו־כלכלה
items.concept: מיצר ימי, מכלית ותשתיות אנרגיה המחוברות למערכת מים.
items.subject: A narrow dusty blue-grey maritime channel between two flat warm ivory shores in the LEFT third. A beautifully detailed small oil tanker passes through the constriction at lower-left, with a tiny amber channel buoy. On the upper-left shore, a sculpted water reservoir and restrained curved dam feed a thin river; on the near left shore two ivory cylindrical storage tanks and an olive pipeline lead toward a small offshore energy platform at the far-left edge. Carefully organized, not a collage: one continuous cartographic coastal model linking water and energy to a narrow trade passage. Main hero is the tanker in the narrow channel. Low shores, no mountain ranges, no real-world country outline, no warships or smoke.

items.title: לחימה בשטח בנוי
items.concept: עיר בחתך: מגדלים, רחובות ורשת תת־קרקעית.
items.subject: An elegant architectural sectional model of a dense CITY, wholly on the LEFT third. Two tall slender ivory towers rise above tightly packed low buildings and one narrow curving alley, contrasting with a straight avenue. The ground is cleanly cut away in the lower-left foreground to reveal a connected pair of simple underground service tunnels, their hollow warm interiors visible through a crisp ivory earth cross-section. One tiny amber accent marks a stairwell joining underground to street. Rich windows, rooftops and subtle olive courtyard trees, subtle deep olive tunnel shadows. The city’s above-ground / street / below-ground vertical structure must be unmistakable and beautifully proportioned, not a ruined city. No mountains, no soldiers, no weapons, no text.

items.title: גבולות, עומק אסטרטגי ואזורי חיץ
items.concept: גדר גבול ורצועת חיץ המרוחקות מיישוב.
items.subject: High oblique miniature of a border landscape on FLAT agricultural land, LEFT third only. A long slim olive fence with regular posts runs diagonally from far upper-left toward lower-middle-left, beside a clearly empty wide pale buffer strip. One small ivory observation tower and a gate interrupt the fence rhythm. Several geometric fields separate the border from a compact cluster of ivory homes at lower-left, so the geographic depth and open distance are clear. A thin meandering dusty blue-grey river at the far-left edge contrasts natural with artificial boundary. One tiny amber gate accent, fine tree lines and service road. No real country map, no flags, no troops, no mountains, no attack arrows. Geometric rhythm and spatial distance are the main story.

items.title: GIS וניתוח מרחבי
items.concept: שכבות ראסטר, וקטור וניתוח מעל מודל של יישוב ורשת דרכים.
items.subject: A beautiful exploded stack of THREE thin translucent ivory tracing-paper MAP SHEETS floating directly above one small geographic model at LEFT third. Strong clear layered silhouette. Base model is a flat ivory small town, road junction and dusty blue-grey river with bridge. The bottom raised sheet carries subtle olive raster cells; middle raised sheet carries delicate olive vector roads, small points and one parcel outline; top raised sheet has a fine short amber route and a subtle circular buffer around one node. The sheets all share the same aligned footprint, parallel and separated vertically by generous air. Real paper thickness, soft shadows, fragile ivory edges, matte tracing paper not glass. No mountains, screens, holograms, letters, numbers, chart legend, satellite or technology icons. The stacked layers are the main subject.
